notes: The final code in src/App.tsx and src/player.css uses @videojs/react@10.0.0-beta.23 (and @videojs/html). I verified each imported symbol against the package's published d.ts files: BufferingIndicator, CaptionsButton, Container, Controls (with .Root), Gesture, Hotkey, MuteButton, PiPButton, PlaybackRateButton, PlayButton, Poster, TimeSlider (with .Root/.Track/.Buffer/.Fill/.Thumb), Time (with .Value), and createPlayer all exist as exports of '@videojs/react'; videoFeatures is exported from '@videojs/react/video' and HlsVideo from '@videojs/react/media/hls-video'. Component props and render-callback state shapes match (PlayButton state.paused, MuteButton state.muted, BufferingIndicator state.visible, Time.Value type='current'|'duration'). Hotkey props (keys/action/value) and the action names togglePaused, toggleMuted, seekStep, seekToPercent are valid HotkeyActionNames; the Gesture action 'toggleControls' is a valid GestureActionName, and pointer/region values match the published unions. The CSS custom properties --media-slider-buffer and --media-slider-fill, plus data-visible, data-dragging, and data-availability='unavailable'|'unsupported', all appear in the library's own skin CSS. No factually wrong API usages were found in the final state.
